review_scope: Read-only source/design review; no application imports, tests, network or server calls.
required_before_execution: Fresh RootDirectory built solely from the exact49-file desktop kit:41 original release files from independently trusted Git blobs, original SOURCE_MANIFEST, two exact private fixture configuration/policy files and five persisted unsigned package files.
Release/configuration/policy and outer/nested package trust pins must derive from independently retained evidence before accepting incoming kit assertions.
No original /opt tree or old lab directory is mounted into the fresh root; enumerate and disclose all allowed read-only OS interpreter/library mounts.
Reconstruct only required protected runtime/layout paths at their exact original logical names; no configuration, policy, captured timestamp or package rewrite.

No real signer read or copy; configured signer paths must remain absent in the fresh unsigned root, or be explicitly reviewed distinct empty unreadable masks; no RPC, Cast, network transaction, live service, website or heartbeat action.
Run a deliberate missing-configuration native keeper verify refusal in a separate incomplete root before the successful path; retain its sanitized failure outcome and prove restore outputs absent.
Run existing journal verify/restore and sidecar verify/restore CLIs once each on the successful path, with defaults unchanged and explicit historical age review only.
Save exact raw record length/hash equality, pending/accounting/outbox/sequence/first_seen equality, native output bindings, new empty private lock metadata and all false approval fields.

Bound inventories, reads, transfer encodings, subprocess output, time, memory, process count and cleanup; SSH response remains64KiB, reviewed tar.gz input remains at most2MiB; preserve incomplete/uncertain outputs rather than auto-delete.
Stop only the new unit and prove its group empty; compare original source/package/configuration/policy/lock records and pre-existing host service states.
Publish only explicitly allowlisted sanitized evidence; raw packages, private configuration/policy and transport captures remain outside Git.
evidence_boundary: Finite same-server application/layout reconstruction with explicitly reused OS runtime; not an independent second host, whole-OS disaster recovery, production fencing, physical durability, canonical transaction proof or readiness approval.
